# Proofs for the Lean code generated by Aeneas

This is a Lake project that depends on the Lean library of Aeneas. Each file in
[`Proofs/`](Proofs/) consists of the definitions that Aeneas generated from one
crate of the [Rust workspace](../rust_workspace/README.md), followed by
specifications and proofs. The files, in the order of the session:

| File | Rust crate | Contents |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [`AddTen_verified.lean`](Proofs/AddTen_verified.lean) | `add_ten` | The type `Result`; the machine integers `U32`; addition that fails on overflow; the notation `⦃ ⦄`; the tactics `step` and `scalar_tac`; a specification, its hypothesis form, and a statement of failure. |
| [`ErrorCodes_verified.lean`](Proofs/ErrorCodes_verified.lean) | `error_codes` | A constant and a structure; the Rust type `Result` inside the Lean type `Result`; an invariant established by a constructor function; combining two specifications. |
| [`Mersenne31_verified.lean`](Proofs/Mersenne31_verified.lean) | `mersenne31` | Addition modulo the prime `2 ^ 31 - 1`; preconditions that exclude overflow; a subtraction that fails on a negative result. |
| [`MaxArray_verified.lean`](Proofs/MaxArray_verified.lean) | `max_array` | A `while` loop: the loop body, `ControlFlow` and `loop`; a loop invariant and a measure; theorems tagged `@[step]`. |
| [`XorCipher_verified.lean`](Proofs/XorCipher_verified.lean) | `xor_cipher` | A loop that modifies an array; an invariant in five parts; the tactic `bv_tac`; the round-trip property. |

The crates `enums` and `affine_cipher` of the Rust workspace have no file here.

From the folder `day-4/aeneas/lean_proofs/`, `lake exe cache get` downloads the
compiled Mathlib, and `lake build` compiles the Aeneas library and all files in
`Proofs/`.
